Role Login · v4.4

Complete POC update · 4 October 2026

Demo credentials and responsibilities

Open login.html, or open index.html to be redirected to login when no session exists. Every listed account uses password Demo@123.

User IDRoleWorkspace scope / actions
A1Schoolnet AdminAll projects, users, role assignments, training plans, batches, central master data, resources and reports.
A2ERNET AdminMonitor assigned projects and training activities (sample P1).
A3State AdminMonitor assigned state/project (sample Karnataka, P1).
A4School AdminMonitor the assigned school (sample S1, P1).
A5TrainerManage trainees, approval and attendance in assigned batches. Manage own availability and upload resources when granted permission. Existing trainer allocation is retained; schedule editing remains an administrator action.
A6Trainee Teacher / StudentRegister through a batch link, view assigned training, access permitted resources, complete assessments and provide feedback (sample U1, B1).

Login behavior

Valid User ID/password opens the workspace, using existing role, project, state, school, trainer or trainee scope. The sidebar displays User ID, name, role and Logout. The persona selector is disabled during credential login. Use Login / switch user or Logout to change users.

Demo review remains available on the login page: select a persona and Enter demo review. The dashboard selector then remains active and lists User ID plus role. Mode changes preserve the local training/master data. They clear the prior selected batch. Invalid credentials show a generic error; blocked session storage shows an error rather than success.

Protected workspace pages redirect to login when no session exists. Restricted role pages display a permission message and a Dashboard link. Batch registration links remain public and batch-specific; visitors see only registration navigation and may log in through the header.

Review walkthrough

  1. Extract the complete ZIP. Run python -m http.server 8080 in a command terminal in the extracted folder. On Windows, py -m http.server 8080 may also be used. This is a terminal command, not Python prompt code.
  2. Open http://localhost:8080/login.html (index.html also redirects here).
  3. Enter A1 and Demo@123. Check the sidebar identity, central controls, fixed role selector and navigation between pages.
  4. Logout and repeat using A2–A6. Verify that project/state/school/batch/trainee scope matches the account.
  5. Try a wrong password. Use Enter demo review to check the existing index persona selector.

Prototype boundary

This is local demonstration login. The published password is a JavaScript constant and sessions are stored in sessionStorage for this browser tab. Passwords are not written to the session or user records. Six sample accounts are supported; creating a new user role record does not provision production credentials. All role/data controls are client-side demonstrations and can be bypassed by modifying browser data. A secure backend, password hashing, credential provisioning, session validation and server authorization are required for real authentication. The POC does not claim these controls.

Data remains in the current browser; real OTP remains simulated. Browser layout, actual browser navigation/clipboard/IndexedDB and visual responsiveness remain unverified. Automated login tests use non-browser fixtures.
